title: Empty input is a real case
summary: An empty list has no items. Decide what your program should do with it before writing a test.
introduction: An empty list has no items. Decide what your program should do with it before writing a test. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain empty input is a real case
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An empty list has no items. Decide what your program should do with it before writing a test.

blocks.code:
const total = values => values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
console.log(total([]));
blocks.title: Empty input is a real case

blocks.text: The result is 0. The starting value lets reduce handle an empty array.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Without the starting value, reduce on an empty array throws an error.
